name: Viral & trend operating system
purpose: Teach agents how to ride trends and engineer shareability without copying specific sounds, creators, or copyrighted clips.
principles: Borrow the FORMAT, invent the PAYLOAD.
The first 1.0–1.5s must signal the format (POV, stitch, GRWM, challenge) before the brand.
One joke / one insight / one emotion per cut. Virality dies when you stack asks.
Participation > polish for trend_reactive work; polish > participation for premium_cinema.
Plan the comment bait: disagreement, tags, stitches, or utility saves.
Never use tragic news, protected trademarks, or unlicensed event footage as a 'moment'.
Paid + organic twins: shoot once, cut native-first, then a cleaner paid cut.

trend_classes.name: Audio / sound ride
trend_classes.how_to_adapt: Keep timing and energy; rewrite lyrics/lines into product truth; clear audio rights for paid.

trend_classes.name: Editor template ride (CapCut etc.)
trend_classes.how_to_adapt: Fill slots with brand-specific contrasts; do not fight the template timing.

trend_classes.name: Format meme (POV, tell-me-without-telling-me, etc.)
signals: Named format in first caption line
trend_classes.how_to_adapt: Lock the grammar of the format; swap only the niche nouns.

trend_classes.name: Reaction / stitch / duet graph
trend_classes.how_to_adapt: Disagree or escalate with proof; land product as the better method.

trend_classes.name: Participation / challenge loop
trend_classes.how_to_adapt: Make rules copyable in <5 seconds; seed 5+ creator examples before paid.

trend_classes.name: Utility save/share spread
trend_classes.how_to_adapt: Max information density; brand as the deeper resource.

trend_classes.name: Serial narrative cliffhangers
trend_classes.how_to_adapt: Outline all parts before posting part 1; monetize later episodes.

trend_classes.name: Spectacle / craft share (high production)
trend_classes.how_to_adapt: One spectacular idea; still need a brand button; cut vertical + horizontal.

trend_classes.name: Cultural / calendar window
trend_classes.how_to_adapt: Ship inside the window; bridge to an evergreen brand truth; avoid tragedy jacking.

virality_checklist: Is there a comment question or polarizing line?
Would someone save it for utility or rewatch spectacle?
Is the brand memorable after the joke/effect?
Do we have rights for sound, footage, and faces?

weekly_trend_ops.scan: Identify 3 rising formats (not just sounds) in the niche + 3 adjacent niches.
weekly_trend_ops.score: Score each: fit to offer (0-5), production ease (0-5), risk (0-5 inverse).
weekly_trend_ops.ship: Produce 2 native pilots in 48h; boost only winners.
weekly_trend_ops.document: Add a private breakdown to ingest/ using sample-ingest.json — do not commit competitor media.

high_production_bridge.note: Viral and cinema are not enemies. Best systems run both.
playbook: Use spectacle films for brand memory and whitelisting.
Cut 6–15s thumbstop beasts from the same shoot.
Pair every premium film with a native UGC twin that says the same job-to-be-done.
Put trend wrappers around high-prod assets only when the format still reads native.
